sessions.name: Freeze Friday V1
requirement_check: V1 Git tag and baseline manifest exist.
The manifest records commit, Python, dependencies, OS, browser, fonts, locale, timezone, rounding, contract/renderer versions, inputs, sources, hashes, and regeneration command.
CROX and AZO frozen artifacts regenerate without unexplained material differences.
sessions.latest_verification: 82/82 render, PDF, and pixel checks passed on 2026-07-29.

sessions.name: Gate 3 Eligibility and Freshness Contract
requirement_check: Gate 4 consumes only the immutable standardized Gate 3 contract.
Contract version, report/financial/market dates, filing freshness, subsequent events, probability freshness, valuation status, and issuer warnings are validated.
Stale Gate 3 returns GATE_4_BLOCKED_STALE_GATE_3 and does not rebuild or overwrite issuer analysis.

sessions.name: Private Portfolio Schemas
requirement_check: Independent policy, exposure, holdings, opportunity-set, and approval schemas exist.
EXPOSURE_ONLY, AGGREGATED_PORTFOLIO, and FULL_HOLDINGS modes are supported.
CORE_REQUIRED, CONDITIONAL, OPTIONAL, and REVIEWER_CONFIRMED_NOT_APPLICABLE governance is enforced.
sessions.latest_verification: All three modes and exception rules pass the current unit suite.

sessions.name: Privacy Controls and Input Diagnostics
requirement_check: Private workspaces and outputs remain outside the repository.
Git, logs, caches, temporary files, diagnostics, sensitive filenames/content, PDF metadata, attachments, and permissions are controlled.
Private modules remain offline by default.
Missing, stale, contradictory, non-finite, formula, and reconciliation failures generate privacy-safe diagnostics without invented defaults.
sessions.latest_verification: Privacy tests and the Gate 4 pre-commit privacy scan pass.

sessions.name: Reproducible Blind-Test Baseline
requirement_check: ODFL was selected and frozen before its first run.
Company, selection date, industry, intended stress characteristics, pre-run commit, output, errors, warnings, diagnostics, execution context, and hashes are preserved.
The company was not replaced after defects were found.
sessions.scope_reconciliation: Facility, reconciliation, and working-capital fixes made during S05 remain valid shared fixes but are not counted as S05 baseline deliverables or as complete S06 work. The immutable S05 artifacts remain unchanged.

sessions.name: Period, XBRL and Accounting Controls
requirement_check: Quarter, YTD, FY, LTM, instant/flow, unit, currency, share-count, non-calendar, 53-week, negative-denominator, and missing-XBRL controls are implemented.
All analytical rules are owned by the shared Data and Evidence Layer; downstream code only delegates.
Nineteen dedicated positive/negative tests, 141 complete tests, six live company regressions and renderings, an actual 371-day observation, and 82 frozen baseline checks pass.

scope_numbering_correction.old_problem: The cross-industry matrix, safe-failure taxonomy, anti-hardcoding scan, and six-company regression were previously labelled S06 even though they did not implement the agreed S06 data controls.
scope_numbering_correction.correction: Those useful artifacts are retained and relabelled SUP-B01, Supplemental Phase B Testing Governance.

future_completion_rule: Freeze the exact session requirement before implementation.
Map every requirement to its owning shared component and acceptance test.
Do not mark a session complete from adjacent or useful work that belongs to another scope.
Record implementation commit, tests, warnings, unresolved items, and exact next entry point.
Re-run the cumulative session audit when a correction changes an earlier status.
